inventory_status_reason: The 100 entries below are the complete site asset set of carbonphysics.ai as served on 2026-09-28, excluding the five ask-carbon/ assets the integration tool supplies. Basis: the owner-supplied live archive carbon-site-upload-v3-papers.zip (sha256 23fe55aee17ae5468673eb19e7416b710744257de1c178ead339d3daeab3e2cf, 105 files = these 100 + ask-carbon/{ask-carbon.js,ask-carbon.css,release-contract.js,public-knowledge.v1.json,pilot-designer.html}) was fetched path by path from https://carbonphysics.ai and https://www.carbonphysics.ai at 2026-09-28T12:55Z and matched 105/105 on both by SHA-256 (HTML compared after removing the Cloudflare challenge script and Web Analytics beacon the edge injects). Completeness of the archive as the deployed directory is the owner's statement; the per-path match is measured.

supersedes.why_superseded: The v2 manifest (97 entries, build 2026-09-22) was accurate for live through at least 2026-09-26T16:38Z: on that date 96 of its 97 entries matched live by digest on both hostnames and index.html matched as the integrated homepage (measured while building candidate 2026-09-26.1). A later carbonwebsite deployment carrying the v3 Litepaper and Whitepaper changed 53 entries, added 4 and removed 1. Its 'verified-complete' status was therefore true of the older live state and stale afterwards.

routing_configuration.implication: auto-trailing-slash is why /index.html 307-redirects to / and /workbench/index.html 307-redirects to /workbench/; a preservation recipe must fetch the directory URL, never the literal index.html path. not_found_handling "none" means the site's 404.html is not yet served for unknown paths; switching to "404-page" is a separate, optional change via wrangler.carbonwebsite.toml.
